Politics · India

PM's Youthful Image Under Fire

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has been criticized by opposition leader Rahul Gandhi for being out of touch with the youth, who are seen as making history. Gandhi accused Modi of being 'most anti-youth' prime minister in India's history, citing a crackdown on student protests. The criticism comes amid concerns about the government's handling of issues affecting young people.
